g.text: Open land and non-cereal herbs through the Holocene
Lines: area-weighted mean · Shading: spatial grid min–max, not confidence or prediction limits.
Joined window midpoints guide the eye; gaps stay missing. Green: open land, left axis. Orange: indicator, right.
Open-land context: seven herb types, including plantain and natural/wetland vegetation.
Published REVEALS modeled cover · Fyfe et al. 2021, PANGAEA 937075 · Githumbi et al. 2022 · CC BY 4.0.
